title: M1 — Pipelines & Codespaces
body:
**Gate:** CI must pass on first commit.

Firebase dev/prod deployed. Codespaces verified. CI/CD green. Backup scheduled. Runbook v1 drafted. /docs/ structure committed to repo.

title: M2 — Three-View Design System
body:
**Gate:** WCAG AA contrast pass on all 3 palettes.

All components in Storybook. Three-view tokens committed. Photography brief + motion spec drafted. WCAG AA verified.

body:
**Gate:** MFA bypass must be impossible.

Firebase Auth live. MFA enforced for all staff roles. Session management UI live. Audit log writing.

**Sprint:** S4 | **Week:** W8 | **Epic:** E3

body:
**Gate:** Business owner sign-off on visual design + all 8 personas checked.

All 3 view homepages live on dev with real Firestore data. Age gates active. Prefix search working. Mobile-responsive.

body:

Staff can push pawn items to eBay. Status syncs back. Cannabis/fireworks use local-pickup-only correctly.

**Sprint:** S9 | **Week:** W18 | **Epic:** E6

title: M6 — Merchandising Live
body:
**Gate:** Algolia search returns results in < 300ms.

E13 engine live: staff picks, trending, related items, quick-view, collection pages, Algolia. Marcus-grade photography standard active.

**Sprint:** S12 | **Week:** W24 | **Epic:** E13

title: M7 — Beta: Full Feature Set
body:
**Gate:** Internal UAT sign-off from business owner + staff.

Pawn form, click-and-collect, seasonal engine (E14), conversion optimization (E17), CRM basics, compliance hardened. UAT complete.

**Sprint:** S14 | **Week:** W28

title: M8 — AI & Post-Sale
body:
**Gate:** AI description generation tested on 10 real items; Finds of the Week published.

E18 AI assistant live with Marcus-grade provenance copy. E16 post-sale operations. E19 editorial CMS with first 5 articles incl. founder story.

body:
**Gate:** autoFollowUp tested; Marcus cross-view journey validated in CRM.

E15 CRM dashboard live. VIP tiers active (Marcus, Kevin, Jordan). E12 alerts, favourites, SMS active. Weekly personalised digest per view running.

**Sprint:** S17 | **Week:** W34

title: M10 — Staging Sign-Off
body:
**Gate:** All Lighthouse gates pass. UAT pre-launch signed off.

Lighthouse ≥90 all views. Rules audited. Playwright suite passing. Sentry connected. Backup verified. Runbook complete.

**Sprint:** S18 | **Week:** W36

title: M11 — Production Launch
body:
**Gate:** All launch-day checklist items checked. Legal gate cleared.

DNS live. eBay prod keys. Staff trained. Legal sign-off received. GA4 goals live. E12/E15/E17/E18 soft-launched via feature flags.

**Sprint:** S19 | **Week:** W38

title: E1: Set up GitHub org, repo & branch protection
body:
Create GitHub org and repo. Configure branch protection rules on `main` and `develop`. Require PR reviews and passing CI before merge.

**Epic:** E1 | **Sprint:** S1 | **Points:** ~5

title: E1: Scaffold Vite + React 18 + TypeScript project
body:
Initialise Vite 5 project with React 18 and TypeScript 5. Configure `tsconfig.json`, path aliases, and Tailwind v4 CSS-first setup.

**Epic:** E1 | **Sprint:** S1 | **Points:** ~5

title: E1: Configure GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline
body:
Create `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: lint → typecheck → Vitest → build. Create `deploy.yml` with manual approval gate for production via GitHub Environments.

**Epic:** E1 | **Sprint:** S1 | **Points:** ~5

title: E1: Set up Firebase dev + prod projects
body:
Create two Firebase projects (dev/prod). Configure Firestore, Authentication, Hosting, and Cloud Functions v2. Add environment-specific `.env` files (excluded from git).

**Epic:** E1 | **Sprint:** S1 | **Points:** ~5

title: E1: Configure GitHub Codespaces devcontainer
body:
Create `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` with Node 20, Firebase CLI, Firebase emulator suite, and VS Code extensions pre-installed. Verify cold start < 2 minutes.

**Epic:** E1 | **Sprint:** S1 | **Points:** ~3

title: E1: Schedule nightly Firestore backup to GCS
body:
Configure Cloud Scheduler + Cloud Function to export Firestore to a GCS bucket nightly. Add document-count verification step. Document restore procedure in runbook.

**Epic:** E1 | **Sprint:** S1 | **Points:** ~3

title: E1: Draft Operational Runbook v1 — all 9 playbooks
body:
Create `/docs/runbook.md` with all 9 incident playbooks: site down, Firestore outage, eBay API failure, Firebase Auth outage, data breach response, backup restore, hotfix deploy, age-gate failure, Sentry alert triage.

**Epic:** E1 | **Sprint:** S1 | **Points:** ~5

title: E1: Initialise Docs-as-Code /docs/ folder structure
body:
Commit initial `/docs/` structure: `/docs/epics/`, `/docs/adr/`, `/docs/schema/`, `/docs/project-management/`, `/docs/reports/`. Add README in each folder. Add `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` scaffolds and `labels.yml`.

**Epic:** E1 | **Sprint:** S1 | **Points:** ~3

title: E1: Add GitHub Actions workflows — lint, tests, Lighthouse, schema-validation, docs-validation
body:
Create `lint.yml`, `tests.yml`, `lighthouse.yml`, `schema-validation.yml`, `docs-validation.yml`. Wire all checks into PR required status. Lighthouse CI targets: ≥90 performance, ≥90 accessibility, ≥95 SEO.

**Epic:** E1 | **Sprint:** S1 | **Points:** ~5

title: E1: Create GitHub Projects board with custom fields
body:
Set up GitHub Projects board. Add custom fields: Status (Backlog/In Progress/In Review/Done/Blocked), Epic (E01–E19), Priority (P0/P1/P2), View Context (Pawn/Cannabis/Fireworks/All), Sprint (S01–S19), Persona Impact, Compliance Impact, Schema Impact, AI Review Required, QA Status, Deployment Risk.

**Epic:** E1 | **Sprint:** S1 | **Points:** ~2

title: E1: Apply full label taxonomy to repository
body:
Apply all labels from `/docs/project-management/labels.yml`: view:pawn, view:cannabis, view:fireworks; type:feature/bug/hotfix/compliance/adr; priority:p0/p1/p2; area:frontend/backend/schema/design/ai/search/inventory/crm; persona:makoonsii/dale/tanya/marie/kevin/sandra/jordan/marcus.

**Epic:** E1 | **Sprint:** S1 | **Points:** ~2

title: E2: Define Tailwind v4 base @theme — gold/black palette (Pawn view)
body:
Configure `--color-primary: #C8A14A`, `--color-bg: #080706`. Set `--font-display: Playfair Display`, `--font-body: IM Fell English`. Create `.view-pawn` CSS class. Load Google Fonts.

**Epic:** E2 | **Sprint:** S2 | **Points:** ~5

title: E2: Build core Pawn view component library (Button, Badge, Card, Modal, Input, Table)
body:
Create base components scoped to `.view-pawn`. All components must pass WCAG AA contrast. Add Storybook stories for all variant states (default, hover, disabled, error).

**Epic:** E2 | **Sprint:** S2 | **Points:** ~8

title: E2: Configure PWA manifest + Workbox service worker
body:
Create `manifest.json` with per-view icons and theme colours. Configure Workbox for offline shell caching. Test install prompt on mobile.

**Epic:** E2 | **Sprint:** S2 | **Points:** ~3

title: E2: Draft Motion Design Spec
body:
Document animation timing, easing curves, transition durations for the dark luxury aesthetic. Define entrance animations for hero, cards, modals. Commit to `/docs/design/motion-spec.md`.

**Epic:** E2 | **Sprint:** S2 | **Points:** ~3

body:
Create photography brief defining dark luxury standard applicable to all three views. Document lighting, background, props, post-processing requirements. This is the baseline for Marcus persona engagement.

Commit to `/docs/design/photography-brief.md`.

title: E2: Cannabis view token overrides + component variants

Add `--color-primary: #7B4FA0`, `--color-bg: #1A0D2E`. Fonts: Cormorant Garamond (display) / DM Sans (body). Create `.view-cannabis` class. Build cinematic hero, mood collection card, luxury product card variants.

**Epic:** E2 | **Sprint:** S3 | **Points:** ~8

title: E2: Fireworks view token overrides + component variants
body:
Add `--color-primary: #C0392B`, `--color-bg: #1A0A0A`. Fonts: Bebas Neue (display) / Oswald (body). Create `.view-fireworks` class. Build countdown timer, bundle card, urgency badge components.

**Epic:** E2 | **Sprint:** S3 | **Points:** ~8

title: E2: Implement ViewContext provider

Create React context that reads the URL prefix (`/pawn`, `/cannabis`, `/fireworks`) and injects the corresponding CSS class on the root element, enabling theme switching without JS conditionals.

**Epic:** E2 | **Sprint:** S3 | **Points:** ~3

title: E2: WCAG AA contrast audit — all three view palettes
body:
Run automated contrast checks on all three view palettes. Fix any failures. Document results in `/docs/reports/wcag-audit-sprint3.md`. Integrate axe-core into CI.

**Epic:** E2 | **Sprint:** S3 | **Points:** ~3

title: E3: Firebase Auth — email/password + Google SSO
body:
Configure Firebase Authentication with email/password and Google SSO providers. Implement AuthContext and ProtectedRoute components.

**Epic:** E3 | **Sprint:** S4 | **Points:** ~5

title: E3: Role system — admin, manager, inventory_staff, marketing_staff, customer
body:
Implement custom claims for 5 roles. Create Cloud Function to assign/revoke roles. Add role-gated ProtectedRoute variants. Document role matrix in `/docs/project-management/roles.md`.

**Epic:** E3 | **Sprint:** S4 | **Points:** ~5

title: E3: MFA enforcement — TOTP/SMS mandatory for all staff roles
body:
Enable Firebase Auth MFA APIs. Enforce TOTP or SMS second factor for admin, manager, inventory_staff, marketing_staff roles on first login. MFA bypass must be impossible — this is an acceptance gate for M3.

**Epic:** E3 | **Sprint:** S4 | **Points:** ~8

title: E3: Session management UI + suspicious login alerts
body:
Build staff-facing session management page (active sessions, revoke). Implement suspicious login detection (new IP/device) with email alert to account owner.

**Epic:** E3 | **Sprint:** S4 | **Points:** ~5

title: E3: Audit log — write authentication events to Firestore
body:
Write login, logout, role change, MFA enrolment, and suspicious login events to `auditLogs/{id}` collection. Ensure audit logs cannot be deleted by non-admin roles.

**Epic:** E3 | **Sprint:** S4 | **Points:** ~3

body:
Define and document Firestore `items/{id}` schema: viewTag, viewTags, locationId, isSeasonalItem, bundleIds, merchandisingTags, videoUrl, aiDescription, aiPriceSuggestion, provenanceNotes (new in v5.0 for Marcus). Commit schema to `/docs/schema/inventory.md`.

**Epic:** E4 | **Sprint:** S5 | **Points:** ~5

title: E4: Add Item admin form + intake workflow
body:
Build admin form for creating inventory items. Implement intake workflow: receive → condition grading → photography → pricing → publish. Support all three viewTags.

**Epic:** E4 | **Sprint:** S5 | **Points:** ~8

title: E4: Multi-image upload + per-view watermark
body:
Implement multi-image upload to Firebase Storage. Apply per-view watermark overlay on upload. Serve WebP/AVIF via Firebase Hosting CDN.

**Epic:** E4 | **Sprint:** S5 | **Points:** ~5

title: E4: Hold system + holdExpiry Cloud Function
body:
Implement item hold/reservation: status → `reserved`, `holdExpiresAt` timestamp. Cloud Function resets expired holds to `active` every 30 minutes. Admin UI shows holds dashboard.

**Epic:** E4 | **Sprint:** S5 | **Points:** ~5

title: E4: Barcode/QR generation + searchTokens
body:
Generate QR label per item. Build `searchTokens` array from title/category for prefix search. Expose QR print view in admin.

**Epic:** E4 | **Sprint:** S5 | **Points:** ~5

title: E5: Pawn view homepage — hero, trust strip, featured grid, brand narrative, masonry
body:

Featured inventory grid (4 active items). Brand narrative callout (Makoonsii trust signal). Masonry discovery section (Sandra impulse browsing).

title: E5: Pawn shop page — inventory grid, filters, prefix search, item detail

**Epic:** E5 | **Sprint:** S6 | **Points:** ~8

title: E5: Cannabis view homepage + shop + item detail — cinematic hero, mood collections, luxury product card
body:
Build Cannabis homepage: cinematic full-bleed hero, mood collection cards (Relax/Focus/Social/Ceremony for Marie), lifestyle editorial strip. Shop page and item detail with macro image gallery and hover reveal. Limited-edition framing for Marcus.

**Epic:** E5 | **Sprint:** S7 | **Points:** ~8

Full-screen 19+ confirmation modal — no bypass. On confirm: write consentLogs doc (IP, timestamp, policy version, viewTag=cannabis). Add `/legal/cannabis` page.

**Epic:** E5 | **Sprint:** S7 | **Points:** ~5

title: E5: Fireworks view homepage + shop + item detail — countdown timer, event categories, bundle cards
body:
Build Fireworks homepage: animated countdown timer hero (Tanya), event category navigation (Family Night/Display Shows/Sparklers & Kids/Professional), bundle showcase, urgency strip. Shop page and item detail with urgency copy and pickup scheduling CTA.

**Epic:** E5 | **Sprint:** S8 | **Points:** ~8

title: E5: Fireworks 19+ age gate + consent logging
body:
Full-screen 19+ confirmation modal for /fireworks — no bypass. On confirm: write consentLogs doc (IP, timestamp, policy version, viewTag=fireworks). Add `/legal/fireworks` page.

**Epic:** E5 | **Sprint:** S8 | **Points:** ~3

title: E5: Mobile-responsive audit — all three views at 375px / 768px / 1280px
body:
Audit all three view homepages, shop pages, and item detail pages at 375px (mobile), 768px (tablet), and 1280px (desktop). Fix all layout breaks. Large touch targets for Makoonsii.

**Epic:** E5 | **Sprint:** S8 | **Points:** ~5

title: E6: eBay OAuth + ebayListItem Cloud Function
body:
Implement eBay OAuth token flow. Build `ebayListItem` Cloud Function: map Firestore item fields to eBay listing format, condition mapping, apply cannabis/fireworks local-pickup-only policy.

title: E6: ebayPublishOffer, ebaySyncStatus (4h schedule), ebayRefreshToken (daily)

**Epic:** E6 | **Sprint:** S9 | **Points:** ~8

title: E6: Admin cross-post dashboard — eBay toggle, Kijiji draft, Facebook deep-link
body:
Build admin cross-post dashboard: per-item eBay toggle, listing status, Kijiji draft generation, Facebook deep-link. Cannabis/fireworks items auto-flag as local-pickup-only.

**Epic:** E6 | **Sprint:** S9 | **Points:** ~8

title: E7: Multi-step pawn form — item details, condition, contact, serial number, anonymous option
body:
Build multi-step pawn submission form: item details → condition → contact method (with anonymous option) → serial number capture. Submit to `pawnRequests/{id}` collection. Run serial number blacklist check on submit.

**Epic:** E7 | **Sprint:** S10 | **Points:** ~8

title: E7: Admin pawn inbox — status updates, police hold toggle, reply workflow
body:
Build admin pawn inbox: list all pawnRequests, status update (received/quoted/accepted/completed/rejected), police hold toggle (prevents auto-purge), staff reply workflow with email notification to customer.

**Epic:** E7 | **Sprint:** S10 | **Points:** ~8

title: E7: Serial number blacklist check Cloud Function
body:
On `pawnRequests` create: run submitted serial number against stolen goods blacklist. Flag result in pawnRequest doc. Alert staff inbox if match found. Document blacklist update procedure in runbook.

**Epic:** E7 | **Sprint:** S10 | **Points:** ~5

title: E8: Click-and-collect full workflow — reserve, staff notification, pickup window, SMS/email
body:
Implement click-and-collect: customer reserves item → item status → `pending_pickup` → staff notification → staff confirms pickup window → SMS + email confirmation sent to customer.

**Epic:** E8 | **Sprint:** S15 | **Points:** ~8

title: E8: Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp button, Google Maps, Instagram feed
body:
Add Facebook Messenger deep-link, WhatsApp contact button (critical for Marie's anonymous inquiry path), Google Maps embed, Instagram feed widget to relevant pages.

**Epic:** E8 | **Sprint:** S16 | **Points:** ~5

title: E8: Newsletter CASL double opt-in + reseller registration form
body:
Implement CASL-compliant double opt-in newsletter signup. Per-view subscription (Mailchimp/Buttondown) with viewTag stored in Firestore. Build reseller registration form with staff review workflow.

**Epic:** E8 | **Sprint:** S16 | **Points:** ~5

title: E9: Lighthouse CI gates — ≥90 performance, ≥90 accessibility, ≥95 SEO
body:
Configure Lighthouse CI in GitHub Actions for all three view URLs. Set hard gates: performance ≥90, accessibility ≥90, SEO ≥95. Gate must pass before any production deploy.

**Epic:** E9 | **Sprint:** S16 | **Points:** ~3

title: E9: Firestore security rules audit
body:
Audit all Firestore security rules. Verify: public read on `items` only for `status=active`, owner-only reads on `users/{uid}`, create-only on `consentLogs`, admin-only on `auditLogs`. Run Firebase emulator security rules test suite.

**Epic:** E9 | **Sprint:** S16 | **Points:** ~5

title: E9: CSP headers + Firebase App Check + hCaptcha + honeypot + IP rate-limit
body:
Configure Content Security Policy headers via Firebase Hosting. Enable Firebase App Check. Add hCaptcha to pawn form. Add honeypot field. Implement IP-based rate limiting on Cloud Functions.

**Epic:** E9 | **Sprint:** S16 | **Points:** ~5

title: E9: WebP + AVIF image pipeline
body:
Implement automated WebP and AVIF conversion on image upload via Cloud Function. Serve via Firebase Hosting CDN with appropriate Accept headers.

**Epic:** E9 | **Sprint:** S16 | **Points:** ~3

title: E9: Sentry error monitoring integration
body:
Integrate Sentry into both frontend (React) and Cloud Functions. Configure source map upload on deploy. Set up alert rules for error rate spikes. Test with a deliberate error trigger.

**Epic:** E9 | **Sprint:** S16 | **Points:** ~3

title: E9: Playwright E2E full smoke suite
body:
Build Playwright smoke suite covering: all three view homepages, age gates, item detail, pawn form submission, admin login + MFA, inventory add. Run in CI on every PR to main.

**Epic:** E9 | **Sprint:** S16 | **Points:** ~8

title: E10: Admin analytics dashboard — per-view sales velocity, aging, most viewed
body:
Build admin analytics dashboard: per-view sales velocity, inventory aging, most-viewed items, top categories, pawn conversion funnel. Source data from Firestore + GA4.

**Epic:** E10 | **Sprint:** S13 | **Points:** ~8

title: E10: UTM attribution per-view dashboard
body:
Track UTM parameters on all three views. Build attribution dashboard in admin: traffic by source (Facebook/eBay/Instagram/Google Maps/TikTok), per-view conversion, customer acquisition cost.

**Epic:** E10 | **Sprint:** S13 | **Points:** ~5

title: E10: Feature flag system — Firestore config/featureFlags + useFeatureFlag hook
body:
Implement feature flag key-value store in `config/featureFlags`. Build `useFeatureFlag(key)` React hook that reads flags on app init. Use for E12/E15/E17/E18 soft rollout at launch.

**Epic:** E10 | **Sprint:** S10 | **Points:** ~3

title: E10: Audit log viewer in admin portal
body:
Build admin audit log viewer: filterable list of all auth events, inventory changes, role changes, pawn status updates. Read from `auditLogs` collection. Admin-only access.

**Epic:** E10 | **Sprint:** S10 | **Points:** ~5

title: E11: PIPEDA data retention + purgeExpiredData Cloud Function
body:
Implement monthly `purgeExpiredData` Cloud Function: auto-purge pawnRequests (no police hold) after 90 days, reseller leads after 1 year. Police hold = true blocks purge. Consent logs and audit logs NOT auto-purged.

**Epic:** E11 | **Sprint:** S7 | **Points:** ~5

title: E11: Jurisdiction notices — indigenous legal consultation gate
body:
Create `/legal/` pages with jurisdiction disclosure copy for all three views. Copy must be reviewed and approved by counsel before launch. **HARD GATE for M11.** Schedule for Sprint 16 (Week 32). If delayed, launch date adjusts.

**Epic:** E11 | **Sprint:** S16 | **Points:** ~3

title: E11: Accessibility compliance program — /accessibility page, keyboard audit, NVDA/VoiceOver QA, axe-core CI
body:
Build `/accessibility` page. Conduct full keyboard navigation audit on all three views. Test with NVDA (Windows) and VoiceOver (Mac/iOS). Integrate axe-core into CI. Fix all critical failures.

**Epic:** E11 | **Sprint:** S16 | **Points:** ~8

title: E11: Stolen goods blacklist — admin management UI
body:
Build admin UI for managing the serial number blacklist. Allow admin to add/remove/search entries. Integrate with pawn form check Cloud Function.

title: E12: Saved searches + category alerts + favourites/wishlist
body:

**Epic:** E12 | **Sprint:** S19 | **Points:** ~5

title: E12: Notification centre + SMS alerts (Twilio)
body:
Build in-app notification centre. Integrate Twilio for SMS alerts. New inventory matching a saved search triggers SMS/email within 60 seconds of listing. Kevin and Dale primary targets.

**Epic:** E12 | **Sprint:** S19 | **Points:** ~8

title: E12: Seasonal reminders + pickup confirmation via SMS
body:
Implement seasonal reminder campaigns (CRM-triggered). Send pickup confirmation SMS to customers when click-and-collect window is confirmed. Primary persona: Tanya.

**Epic:** E12 | **Sprint:** S19 | **Points:** ~5

title: E13: Staff picks admin UI + trending score Cloud Function
body:

title: E13: Collection pages, bundle recommendations, just-arrived + rare find auto-tagging
body:

body:

body:

title: E13: Masonry discovery section (Sandra) + vertical video support (cannabis/fireworks)
body:

body:

title: E17: Social proof widgets — transaction counters, years in business, testimonials, recently sold strip
body:
Build social proof widget set: transaction counters, years in business badge, testimonials module, recently sold strip (primary trigger for Dale and Kevin). Recently sold data sourced from Firestore `onItemSold` events.

**Epic:** E17 | **Sprint:** S14 | **Points:** ~5

title: E17: Live activity feed — rate-limited, privacy-safe
body:
Build live activity feed showing what other users are currently viewing. Rate-limited to prevent performance impact. Privacy-safe: no PII, generalised as 'Someone from Cornwall is viewing this'. Primary for Sandra's sense of shared discovery.

**Epic:** E17 | **Sprint:** S14 | **Points:** ~5

title: E17: Scarcity indicators — limited edition flag for Marcus + urgency modules
body:
Build scarcity/limited-edition flag display (Marcus responds to rarity, not manufactured urgency). Add low-stock urgency module. Hold countdown badge on reserved items. All scarcity signals must be authentic — not fake.

**Epic:** E17 | **Sprint:** S14 | **Points:** ~5

title: E17: A/B experiment framework — Firebase Remote Config + GA4
body:
Implement A/B experiment framework using Firebase Remote Config for variant assignment and GA4 custom events for conversion tracking. Document experiment runbook in `/docs/project-management/ab-testing.md`.

**Epic:** E17 | **Sprint:** S14 | **Points:** ~5

title: E18: generateAIDescription Cloud Function — GPT-4o, staff review gate
body:
Build `generateAIDescription` callable Cloud Function. Prompt GPT-4o with item details + photography context. Staff reviews before publish — no auto-publish. For Marcus items: prompt must include provenance, cultural context, and collecting significance.

**Epic:** E18 | **Sprint:** S17 | **Points:** ~8

title: E18: eBay title optimization + auto-tagging (min 3 suggestions) + category recommendation
body:
Extend AI assistant: eBay-optimised title generation (character limits, keyword density). Auto-tagging with minimum 3 tag suggestions per item. Category recommendation from item description. Staff can accept/edit all suggestions.

**Epic:** E18 | **Sprint:** S17 | **Points:** ~5

title: E18: Price suggestion — eBay sold comps for Dale + duplicate detection
body:
Build price suggestion feature: query eBay sold comps API, return price range (not a specific price). Display to staff as guidance only. Implement duplicate detection: flag items with similar title/category already in Firestore.

**Epic:** E18 | **Sprint:** S17 | **Points:** ~5

title: E19: Editorial CMS — blog/article admin UI + articles Firestore collection
body:
Build editorial CMS: admin article editor (title, body, viewTag, slug, seoMeta, publishedAt). Public article list and detail pages per view. Include RSS feed. `articles/{id}` Firestore collection.

**Epic:** E19 | **Sprint:** S19 | **Points:** ~8

title: E19: Brand narrative — About page, founder story, Akwesasne identity, Warriors of Akwesasne series
body:
Write and publish: About page with founder story, Akwesasne identity section (Dapper. Debonair. Distinctly Akwesasne.). Launch Warriors of Akwesasne editorial series. **All Kanien'kéha phrases require community review and approval before publication.** Marcus and Makoonsii primary audiences.

**Epic:** E19 | **Sprint:** S19 | **Points:** ~5

title: E19: Finds of the Week — launch edition published at M11
body:
Publish first Finds of the Week editorial at launch. Feature the shop owner's personal selections across all three views. Curated weekly highlights format. Marcus and Sandra primary audience. Must be live at M11.

**Epic:** E19 | **Sprint:** S19 | **Points:** ~3

title: E19: Local SEO landing pages (≥6) + FAQ engine + buying guides
body:
Create minimum 6 local SEO landing pages (Cornwall, Akwesasne, surrounding region — per view). Build FAQ engine (admin-editable Q&A). Publish initial buying guides (collectibles, cannabis wellness, fireworks safety).

**Epic:** E19 | **Sprint:** S19 | **Points:** ~8

title: Launch: DNS cutover — A/AAAA records → Firebase prod hosting
body:
Execute DNS cutover. Point A/AAAA records to Firebase prod hosting IPs. Verify SSL certificate auto-provisioned. Test all three view URLs in production.

**Sprint:** S19 | **Week:** W38

title: Launch: eBay production OAuth credentials + test listing
body:
Switch eBay integration to production OAuth credentials. Publish a test listing and immediately end it. Verify status syncs back to Firestore.

**Sprint:** S19 | **Week:** W38

title: Launch: SendGrid sending domain DKIM/DMARC verification
body:
Verify SendGrid sending domain with DKIM and DMARC records. Send a test pawn inquiry email and confirm receipt. Check spam score.

**Sprint:** S19 | **Week:** W38

title: Launch: Staff MFA enrolment — all admin/manager/inventory_staff accounts
body:
Ensure all staff accounts have MFA enrolled before go-live. Record confirmation in launch-day checklist. Developer + staff must co-verify.

**Sprint:** S19 | **Week:** W38

title: Launch: Record staff Loom training — all three views + admin portal
body:
Record Loom walkthrough covering: Pawn view staff workflow, Cannabis view staff workflow, Fireworks view + campaign scheduler, Admin portal (inventory, pawn inbox, eBay, CRM).

**Sprint:** S19 | **Week:** W38

title: Launch: Legal jurisdiction sign-off — indigenous commerce + Kanien'kéha language review
body:
Obtain written sign-off from legal counsel on all jurisdiction disclosure copy. Obtain community sign-off on all Kanien'kéha phrases before publication. **HARD GATE — launch cannot proceed without this.**

**Sprint:** S16–S19

title: Launch: 7-day post-launch monitoring schedule — Sentry, GA4, Firebase Console
body:
Set up daily post-launch monitoring for 7 days: Sentry error rate review, GA4 conversion goal verification per view, Firebase Console (Firestore reads/writes, function invocations, hosting bandwidth). Document findings in `/docs/reports/`.

**Sprint:** S19 | **Week:** W38–W39

title: ADR-001: Adopt Docs-as-Code with GitHub Projects as PM layer
body:
**Status:** Accepted

Document the architectural decision to use Docs-as-Code philosophy with Markdown files in the repository as the single source of truth. GitHub Projects as the primary PM orchestration layer. No external PM tools (Jira/Asana).

Commit to `/docs/adr/ADR-001-docs-as-code.md`.

**Epic:** E1

title: ADR-002: Three-view architecture with shared Firebase backend
body:
**Status:** Accepted

Document the decision to implement three distinct public-facing views (Pawn/Cannabis/Fireworks) sharing a unified Firebase backend, inventory system, and admin portal. ViewContext + CSS custom properties for theming.

Commit to `/docs/adr/ADR-002-three-view-architecture.md`.

**Epic:** E2

title: ADR-003: Algolia over Firestore full-text search
body:
**Status:** Accepted

Document the decision to adopt Algolia from Sprint 12 (moved earlier per gap analysis). Rationale: typo-tolerance and faceted filtering are critical for collectibles discovery. Firestore prefix tokens used as interim solution in Sprints 1–11.

Commit to `/docs/adr/ADR-003-algolia-search.md`.

**Epic:** E13

title: ADR-004: Staff-side AI only — no customer-facing AI in v5.0
body:
**Status:** Accepted

Document the decision to restrict AI (OpenAI GPT-4o) to staff-facing operations only (description generation, tagging, pricing suggestions). No customer-facing AI chatbot in this build.

Commit to `/docs/adr/ADR-004-staff-only-ai.md`.

**Epic:** E18
